attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication on AlmaLinux 9 nodes: node1 as writable primary, node2/node3 as hot standbys. Created a dedicated cluster CA on node1, issued per-node server certs (CN + SAN matching hostname/IP) and a client cert (CN=replicator) for the replication role. Enforced TLS+client-cert-only replication via hostssl ... cert clientcert=verify-full in pg_hba.conf, restricted to node2/node3 IPs. Verified replication works end-to-end, verified a cert signed by a foreign/self-signed CA is rejected (tlsv1 alert unknown ca), then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving boot_id changed on each and confirming full replication/data recovery afterward.
